text: Your recipe collections now follow your language. Open Nutrition advice to explore.
Steamed, stir-fried or braised? Filter recipes by cooking method.
Try Peruvian and Brazilian dishes in the expanded recipe collections.
Want a precise check-in? Record your weight to two decimal places in kg or lb.
Your first weight check-in earns a badge. Explore all 70 challenge badges!
Every saved meal counts toward the new food-entry badges, even on the same day.
Every saved workout counts toward the new workout-entry badges.
Walk, run or use the elliptical: all recorded cardio miles now count toward distance badges.
Move Seedy where you like. Tips stay beside your companion across pages.
Planning ahead? Build your own workouts in the new training calendar.
How is your day going? Open your health rating for a breakdown.
A little planning helps. Log your next meal with its portion or weight.
Ready to move? Open today’s training plan and choose a movement.
Small steps add up. See your progress in the workout report.
Want a fresh goal? Update your training preferences.
Give a friend a little encouragement. Open your Inbox.
How is your weight trending? Check your daily weight chart.
Any feature you would love? Leave a suggestion in Feedback!
Changes take time. Add your weekly body measurements to follow your progress.
Missed a meal? Choose its date in Nutrition details and catch up.
Peak icons now show a crowned mountain. Explore the Trophy Journey.
Badge levels award 300, 1,000, 3,000, 10,000 and 30,000 XP.
Reach Level 27 at one million XP, then keep climbing through unlimited Peaks.
Peak 1 starts at 1,050,000 XP. Each additional Peak takes another 50,000 XP.
The global leaderboard shows every registered member. Tap a name to view trophies.
The top three global ranks earn weekly XP bonuses on Sunday night Eastern time.
Start a group challenge: choose from 30 fitness and 30 diet options.
Each group can have one open challenge. Different groups can run challenges together.
Thirty-day challenges award 2,000 XP to qualifying finishers.
Group members can add their existing friends without sending invitation emails.
Tap Send message on a friend card to open your private conversation.
Administrators can choose up to 50 Seedy tips for the site. Each selected tip appears before the cycle repeats.
The super admin manages administrator roles. Check your account if your access changes.
Describe your food and its portion to look up editable nutrition estimates.
Meal names and food descriptions stay separate. New descriptions become searchable only after saving.
No food match? Use Google search, then paste and review the nutrition numbers.
Attach a meal photo and open it later from your nutrition report.
Edit a food or exercise entry to correct its log date to today or an earlier date.
Explore 100 Chinese home dishes when using Simplified Chinese.
English recipe collections include Mediterranean, balanced, vegetarian, vegan, DASH and keto dishes.
Spanish recipe collections include Mexican, Peruvian, Ecuadorian, Brazilian and Puerto Rican dishes.
Open a recipe for its cooking outline, publisher reference and video.
Search exercises by name, muscle group or equipment when logging a workout.
Record stairmaster floors, cardio distance and workout minutes for more progress insights.
Use the pencil in workout history to correct an exercise entry.
Check off a completed planned workout to add it to your exercise history.
Body measurements help you follow weekly changes alongside your weight trend.
Compare nutrition and workout reports over 7, 28, 90 days or a full year.
Use Punch reminders to encourage a friend to keep moving.
Change your app language in Account. Navigation and searchable catalogs follow your selection.
